name: D13 direct continuous monitor-evidence interface
status: frozen before target materialization or model fitting
purpose: test whether predicting universal monitor-sufficient statistics directly generalizes better than reconstructing curves and recomputing those statistics
scope: combined D3+D12 TRAIN corpus only; DEV and TEST remain closed

inputs.channels: current generic 61-D physical state and six pairs of raw 8-step action chunks
inputs.reason_history_excluded: isolate output-interface causality; exact causal event history already failed D9c/D11/D12

continuous_targets.boundary: unchanged v0 scaling-law BIC difference over all six refinement levels
continuous_targets.commitment: unchanged v0 narrowest-pair whole-trajectory commitment BIC difference
continuous_targets.persistence: unchanged v0 narrowest-pair late-hold persistence BIC difference
continuous_targets.transform: sign(x) * log1p(abs(x)), then per-channel fit-only mean/std normalization
continuous_targets.decision: inverse-transform and use the unchanged zero sign; no fitted threshold

arms.curve_baseline: frozen D12 deterministic checkpoint; recompute all four evidence values from its predicted curves
arms.direct_evidence: same D9b state/action pair encoder with an invariant four-value evidence head
arms.joint: same encoder with both D9b curve reconstruction and four-value direct evidence heads

optimization.joint_loss: evidence MSE plus the six unchanged equally weighted D9b amplitude/shape losses
optimization.execution: one sequential GPU arm at a time

decision.pass_both_axes: replicate the passing arm with seeds 2 and 3 before any DEV run
decision.otherwise: do not tune on validation; if both direct interfaces fail, stop this privileged Jenga encoder family
